en: An illustrated postcard in an Art Nouveau style showing a grand baroque palace with domes and elaborate façades, framed by a decorative black-and-white border. In the foreground are trimmed hedges and a pathway leading to a green door. At the bottom center, within the frame, the building is labeled "SCHLOSS BELVEDERE". Small text in the lower right notes the artist and year, and the bottom left outside the frame has a credit line for an organization.
